title: pedilonum longicalcaratum
intro: Pedilonum longicalcaratum, commonly known as the Chinese calabar bean, is a plant species used in traditional medicine. The health benefits of Pedilonum longicalcaratum include its ability to induce emesis, which makes it useful in treating conditions such as nausea, vomiting, and poisoning. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use as an emetic, purgative, and antihelmintic, making it effective in treating a range of gastrointestinal issues. Bioactive constituents of Pedilonum longicalcaratum include alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
